history.summary: A 1,259 sqft 99-year 3BR at The Rivervale (2001) in D19 Sengkang at $1.36M ($1,080 PSF), served only by Ranggung LRT (610m). Cheap entry and large layout, but an aging 99-yr leasehold with LRT-only access and no URA data is a thin, OCR-mass-market profile.
history.rating_rationale: The appeal is affordability: $1,080 PSF and a $1.36M total for a 1,259 sqft 3BR is cheap and broadly liquid to HDB upgraders in Sengkang. But this is a 2001 (24-year-old) 99-year leasehold — lease decay is now a factor — with only LRT (Ranggung SE5, 610m) connectivity and no URA appreciation/txn data. Mass-market OCR with no specific catalyst; a serviceable but unexciting hold rather than a value buy.
red_flags: 24-year-old 99-yr leasehold — lease decay begins to bite
LRT-only access (no MRT within walking distance)
No URA appreciation or transaction data
OCR mass-market with no specific catalyst
catalysts: Low $1,080 PSF and $1.36M entry appeal to broad HDB-upgrader pool
Sengkang amenities and future Cross Island Line connectivity in the region
